newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer, gasoline up sharpl.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer, gasoline up sharpl.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline firmed sharply, tracking gains on crude and U.S. gasoline futures. Eurograde barges traded at $209.25 and $208 a tonne.
Naphtha was also firmer with traders expecting a tighter market in June.
Outright gas oil prices firmed $4.50 a tonne in line with stronger futures. Heating oil and diesel premiums were steady.
European public holidays left fuel oil markets dull. Prices were notionally steady, with high sulphur barges at $83/$85,
